session.expired: The session is not valid. Open the window again from the tray icon.

connection.step1: On the secondary phone open WhatsApp
connection.step2: Open Linked devices, then Link a device
connection.queue_pending: Messages are waiting in the queue
connection.outdated_banner: WhatsApp library is outdated - update the app
connection.code_expired: The code expired. Show a new one to link.

recipients.name: Name
recipients.empty: No recipients yet. Add the number that should receive notifications.
recipients.invalid_phone: Enter the number in international format, for example +201000000001

voice.key_valid_limited: The key is valid but rate limited:
voice.no_keys: No keys yet. Add a Gemini API key to enable voice notes.
voice.hint_no_key: Add a Gemini key to use voice.
voice.hint_no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg is needed to prepare voice notes. Set its path in Settings.
voice.ffmpeg_label: ffmpeg path (leave empty to detect it)
voice.cooling_down: Every key is rate limited. Voice is back at {time}.
voice.model_same: The fallback must differ from the primary model
voice.intro_label: Speak a short intro before agent voice notes
voice.intro_hint: For example: "Message from Codex, project billing-api." It counts inside the 600-character limit.

rules.paused_until: Paused until {time}. Critical messages still arrive.
rules.paused_forever: Paused until you resume. Critical messages still arrive.
rules.quiet_enabled: Hold info messages during quiet hours
rules.quiet_hint: Held messages arrive as one digest when quiet hours end. Warnings and critical messages always arrive.
rules.rate: Messages per recipient per hour (0 = no limit)
rules.limits_hint: The same text from the same source is sent once per window. Critical messages bypass the hourly limit.
rules.autostart_label: Start DataCodex Notify when I sign in
rules.autostart_on: The app will start with Windows
rules.autostart_off: The app will not start with Windows
rules.alerts_hint: Messages the app writes itself. Choose which ones are sent and how: text, voice, or both. Voice falls back to text when it cannot be produced.
rules.alert_connection_warning: WhatsApp was offline for more than 5 minutes

agents.form_hint: Choose how the agent should report, then copy the prompt and paste it into the agent. The agent writes the instructions into its own rules file. The prompt never contains a password or token.
agents.template_normal: Normal: plus finished phases and stopped implementers
agents.heartbeat: Send a heartbeat so I am alerted if the agent stops
agents.activation_on_request: Only when I ask (may suggest it once)
agents.activate_phrases: Phrases that turn notifications on (one per line)
agents.deactivate_phrases: Phrases that turn notifications off (one per line)
agents.copy_generic_disconnect: Copy a prompt that removes it from any agent
agents.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
agents.notify_connect: Also send a WhatsApp message when an agent connects or disconnects
agents.notify_connect_hint: Off by default. Connections are always shown in this list and in the app log.
agents.notify_connect_on: Notice on connect and disconnect is on
agents.notify_connect_off: Notice on connect and disconnect is off
agents.show_disconnected: Show disconnected sessions older than 1 hour
agents.remove: Remove this session from the list
agents.remove_confirm: Remove this session from the list? Its heartbeats are removed too.
agents.mute_all_hint: Muted agents are told to stop sending for the rest of their session. This is different from Pause, which only delays messages.
agents.rotate_hint: Creates a new access token. Agents that hold the old one are cut off at once. Agents that use the installed program keep working.
agents.rotate_confirm: Create a new access token? Anything using the old token stops working immediately.
agents.skill_hint: The skill teaches Claude Code and Codex how to use the notification program.
agents.skill_remove_confirm: Remove the skill from the Claude Code and Codex skill folders?

home.check_hint: Voice is optional: add a Gemini key in the Voice tab.

settings.unlink_hint: Unlinking removes this device from WhatsApp. You will have to scan a new code.
